title: THE DIFFICULTY PANEL SAYS WHAT EACH CHOICE MEANS
why: Found in the pictures of v34.92: the Settings side panel showed the difficulty row as "difficulty / new player" even while the row said "main game", because the panel keeps a hint only up to its first colon. The hint now names what the choice on the button means: new player is softer hits, longer raids, more loot, fewer extras; main game is standard hits, raid length and loot, extras on; custom is rows changed by hand.
now: The side panel for the difficulty row matches the button: new player, main game or custom.
